text:
This heartbreaking tragedy should also remind us, as parents, that it is our responsibility to work hard and provide the best life we can for our children, rather than placing the burden of uplifting the family on their shoulders.

From what we know, Ateneo gave Rene every opportunity to grow and supported him well. Tragic accidents can happen despite the best preparation, and not everything is within human control. This is a time for compassion, not blame.

I also hope no one takes advantage of this tragedy for personal gain. Let us honor Rene by remembering the kind, humble soul he was. More than anything, he deserves our prayers, our respect, and the peace that comes from allowing his memory to be cherished without division or exploitation.

May Rene and Divine rest in eternal peace, and may God grant strength and comfort to their family and loved ones.
